For **shadow work**, the strongest online options in your results are **JungPlatform’s “Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work,” Charlie Morley’s “Embracing The Shadow” on Awake Academy, ManTalks’ “Shadow Course,” and Insight Timer’s “Shadow Work” courses** because they appear more structured and explicitly focused on inner work and integration[2][9][17][14][18]. For **spiritual practice**, the best fit from these results is usually the platform-based courses on **Insight Timer** and **Awake Academy**, since they combine shadow work with meditation, healing, and broader self-inquiry rather than only technique-based exercises[14][18][9].

Here’s a practical way to choose among them:

| Course | Best for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** | A psychologically grounded introduction | Strong if you want a classic Jungian framing[2] |
| **Embracing The Shadow** | Structured spiritual/transformational work | Good if you want shadow work tied to inner healing and personal growth[9] |
| **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** | Guided self-development | A mainstream personal-growth style course[17] |
| **Insight Timer shadow work courses** | Meditation + reflective practice | Best if you want spiritual practice alongside shadow work[14][18] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Self-paced practice with exercises | Useful if you prefer workbook-style learning[15] |
| **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** | More comprehensive study | Positioned as a fuller training path[4] |

If your goal is **serious shadow work**, start with a course that is clearly **structured, step-by-step, and safety-oriented**, such as the 7-day structured option highlighted in the course hub or the Jungian-based and workbook-driven offerings[8][2][15]. If your goal is **spiritual practice**, prioritize courses that include **meditation, contemplative exercises, or healing-oriented guidance**, especially on Insight Timer and Awake Academy[14][18][9].

A simple recommendation by intent:
- **Best overall for beginners:** **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work**[2]
- **Best for spiritual practice:** **Embracing The Shadow** or an **Insight Timer** course[9][14][18]
- **Best self-paced option:** **Shadow Work Course and Workbook**[15]
- **Best for a broader structured path:** the **7-Day Shadow Work Online Course** or the broader course hub[8]
